record: House of European History official building history
facts: Michel Polak designed the Eastman dental clinic built in 1934–1935. The museum opened there in 2017.
Records the former clinic’s building materials and its architectural redevelopment.

record: Architects’ building description published by the European Parliament
facts: Describes the glass extension and square opaque exhibition boxes within it.
The remodel retained the U-shaped historic building, inserted a new volume in the court and added three floors with a glass facade.
